title: BLADE: Auditing Information Use for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.18780v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model multi-agent systems extend individual agents' capabilities through collaboration across specialized roles, tools, and workflows. Yet collaboration makes failures harder to diagnose: one agent may misinterpret a correct result while others carry the mistake forward. Failure attribution therefore seeks to identify the responsible agent and decisive error step. Recent methods trace dependencies, but knowing where information came from is not the same as knowing where it went wrong. We introduce BLADE (Blame Localization via Audited Dependency Evidence), a training-free framework that moves beyond tracing information to auditing its use. Using Jev for structured probabilistic judgments, BLADE uses dependency probabilities to select relevant source-decision handoffs for auditing. At these handoffs, it examines whether receiving decisions use their sources faithfully and within task requirements, distinguishing error intro

translated_title: BLADE：通过审计信息使用实现大语言模型多智能体系统中的故障归因
translated_abstract: 大语言模型多智能体系统通过跨专门角色、工具和工作流的协作来扩展单个智能体的能力。然而，协作使得故障更难诊断：一个智能体可能误解了正确的结果，而其他智能体又将这一错误继续传递。因此，故障归因旨在识别负有责任的智能体以及决定性的错误步骤。近期的方法通过追踪依赖关系来实现这一目标，但知道信息来自哪里并不等同于知道哪里出了错。我们提出了BLADE（通过审计依赖证据进行责任定位），这是一个无需训练的框架，它超越了信息追踪，转向审计信息的实际使用。BLADE使用Jev进行结构化概率判断，利用依赖概率来选择相关的“源-决策”交接点进行审计。在这些交接点上，它检查接收方决策是否忠实地使用了其信息来源、是否符合任务要求，从而区分错误的引入……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: BLADE是一个无需训练的故障归因框架，它不再仅仅追踪信息的依赖来源，而是审计多智能体系统各交接点上信息的实际使用是否忠实于来源，从而精确定位责任智能体与关键错误步骤。
